verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-premises Trello: the docs describe only the cloud service, its Power-Ups and its REST API. Community posts point the other way, with one user asking for an installable version for internal use and another moving to an open-source alternative.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
